title: A problem of Heittokangas-Ishizaki-Tohge-Wen concerning a certain differential-difference equation
summary: All the finite order entire solutions of \begin{equation*} f^n(z)+q(z)e^{Q(z)}f^{(k)}(z+c)=P(z) \end{equation*} are given, where $ q(z) $, $ Q(z), P(z) $ are polynomials, $ k $ and $ n \geq 2 $ are integers, and $ c \in \mathbb{C} \setminus \{0\} $.This solves an open problem of Heittokangas-Ishizaki-Tohge-Wen [Bull. Lond. Math. Soc. 55, 1-77 (2023)].
